ordering_rules: Ordering key (A9.27 sec. 4; A9.28 msg 1 sec. 7 / msg 2 sec. 15): architecture relevance FIRST, evidence / admission eligibility SECOND, measured runtime THIRD. uq_modular / legacy archengine being slow does not make them port targets: they are retired. Intake response-surface work remains a real active target; F8 robust optimisation is active and may migrate.

Item-7 initial order kept for active physics: W0 TPMC (admitted), W1 intake / design-state geometry sweep, W2 compressor / gas path, W3 mission propagation, W4 UQ / Monte Carlo driver = the active F8 robust optimizer (not uq6 / uq_modular), W5 P3 ray sampling (cathode-free icp_thermal_lib; the P3 v2 cathode node is not ported).

The migration does not stop after W5: every class-A component is scheduled (item 7, zero Python execution dependency); classes G and H reach the end state by formal retirement, not by a port (item 14: 'or has been formally retired').
Profiling ORDERS, never GATES (item 6); no Rust kernel is blocked for lack of a per-kernel profile.

Dependency closure: a Rust component never calls Python at run time. A class-A dependency in a later wave is pulled forward under its own contract (kernel granularity, RM-R17); a class-A component may never depend on a class H / G / F component - each such edge found is listed in dependency_findings and must be removed by extracting the retained kernel, never by porting the legacy module.
Kernel granularity: an extract-and-parity kernel is a function subset of a class-H module; only that subset is ported and parity-tested; the surrounding module stays Python history.
Evidence builders (W15) port after the components they import are admitted; until then they stay Python and keep producing the reference outputs.
One component (or one tightly coupled group named in its contract) per parity contract; no big-bang wave admission (item 1).

Only class-A components, migrating GROUND_TEST_PROGRAMME_ONLY components (lane GT) and the extract_and_parity_kernels of other components are scheduled; class H is the RET lane (not ported), class G the GR lane (on demand), class F the AFI lane (empty at v3).
